stock_segments.discussion_summary: Awardit, loyalty program company, completely crashed on report and now becoming scandal company. Various CEOs had to step down for strange reasons and now latest huge uncrisp and greedy insider sale by founder/former CEO on April 11 - 11 days after quarter ended he had no idea how it went. Staffan Persson on Twitter mocked them without writing out name. Meant completely unreasonable that insider person has no idea how it went when quarter finished. Understand they don't admit because if knew would be bad report and admitted, would sit in prison. Such denial absolutely worthless. Add Financial Supervisory Authority's very strange rules allowing trading in own company as insider after quarter ended - one of sickest things actually. Problem with stock is going through worst journey listed company can make - from overhyped to hated. Read many on Twitter just vomiting hate, so hate against management because feel cheated. Question what such point company as Awardit should be worth. Working towards julklappsvalet.se, what multiple should have. On positive side, Awardit is clear Q4 company so somewhere will be opportunity to own it. Trust crisis. Shows poor morals exploiting loophole. Complete lack of morals perhaps.
